node.statement: Elementary perturbation estimates: contractivity of T and T^2 gives ||A||,||A1||<=||X||, ||B||,||B1||<=||Y||, and ||C||,||C1||<=||Z||. Also ||A1-A||<=eta||X|| and ||B1-B||<=eta||Y||. Hence A1B1-AB=(A1-A)B1+A(B1-B), so ||A1B1-AB||<=2eta||X||||Y||. Consequently ||T(A1B1C)-T(ABC)||<=||(A1B1-AB)C||<=2eta p, and ||T(A1B1)-T^2(AB)||<=||T(A1B1)-T(AB)||+||T(AB)-T^2(AB)||<=2eta||X||||Y||+eta||AB||<=3eta||X||||Y||.
